inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if humanoid programs remain demonstrations, customers vertically integrate actuators, alternative architectures displace DYNAMIXEL, or growing units fail to generate material attributable revenue and margins.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Growth in paid humanoid and advanced-robot deployments can increase ROBOTIS actuator, reducer, hand and platform content, provided design wins become repeat volume with durable owner margins.

objective: Review whether ROBOTIS has a material causal relationship to humanoid robotics and embodied AI through actuators, reducers, hands, platforms and repeat profitable customer demand; accept or reject the edge.
